newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolsa capitalization tripled in year.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolsa capitalization tripled in year.

text.p: Fueled by new share issues and near vertical price rises the Caracas bolsa's market capitalization has more than tripled over the past year to 4.3 trillion bolivars ($9.1 billion), Venezuela's National Securities Commission (CNV) said.

Venezuela's stock market -- which has provided Latin America's highest real returns this year at 80 percent -- stood at 1.2 trillion bolivars ($2.6 billion) in December last year, CNV president Aida Lamus told reporters.

Securities issuance grew 114 percent over 1996 to reach 472 billion bolivars ($1 billion), Lamus said. Of that amount 19 billion bolivars were initial public offerings (IPOs) out of a total 294 billion bolivars in share issues.
National telephone company CANTV accounted for the bulk of IPOs at 15 billion bolivars.
